column1: # Lifecycle evaluation stream: six simulated weeks of a fictional
# person's messages (synthetic: the people, places and events are invented).
# Lines: m<TAB>text                        — a message (observed, doc role)
#        q<TAB>text<TAB>expected           — a query (query role); expected is
# Design: recurring facts get restated across weeks (dedup/strengthen targets),
# one-off trivia should fade, two critical facts are stated exactly ONCE and
# queried weeks later, silence queries probe never-discussed topics.

column2: Finally got the aeroponics rack assembled in the spare room.
The misting runs every fifteen minutes, day and night.
Reservoir holds about twenty liters, should last a week.
The loft is twenty-four hundred a month, utilities excluded.
Movers quoted us for the Houston to Lisbon shipment today.
Started sorting which synths to sell before the move.
Deploys go out Friday mornings, right after standup.
The staging cluster is still on the old runtime version.
Weather has been brutal, thirty-four degrees and humid.
Tried the new ramen place near the office, overrated.
My knee felt fine on today's five kilometer run.
Booked the dentist for the twenty-third.
The landlord wants two months deposit on the loft.
Lettuce seedlings went into the rack today, twelve plugs.
The payment service threw five hundred errors again at peak.
Rotated the API keys after the contractor rolled off.
The community orchard by the river needs its pear trees pruned this autumn.
Watched a documentary about deep sea vents, incredible stuff.
The building has a shared rooftop but our terrace is private.
Sold the old drum machine to a collector in Seoul.
Our friend Dana named her new puppy Biscotto.
The fogger cycles on a quarter-hour interval, seems stable now.
The misting nozzles are the blue ceramic NebulaJet ones.
Swapped the reservoir pump for the quieter model.
Basil cuttings rooted in six days in the aeroponics rack.
The loft lease draft arrived, checking the clauses tonight.
The building manager says register our bikes for the cellar storage before September.
Standup moved to nine thirty so the Friday deploys breathe more.
Fixed the retry storm in the payment service, it was the backoff jitter.
The office espresso machine died and morale died with it.
Ran eight kilometers along the river, knee held up.
The neighbor's cat keeps sleeping on our doormat.
Shipping container slot confirmed for the second week of August.
Il vicino vuole la ricetta della caponata scritta a mano.
Picked up a used Prophet synth in mint condition, couldn't resist.
The dentist filled a small cavity, no drama.
Roadmap review pushed the search feature to next quarter.
夏祭りの花火は川沿いで見るのが一番きれいだった。
Humidity sensor in the rack reads five percent too high, calibrated it.
The rooftop terrace gets full sun until about four in the afternoon.
Landlord agreed to twenty-two hundred a month if we sign for four years.
Lettuce heads are the size of my fist already, aeroponics is absurd.
The staging cluster finally moved to the new runtime.
Killed my old Twitter account, feels great.
Marathon training plan starts Monday, sixteen weeks out.
The Prophet needs new key contacts, ordered a repair kit.
When does the misting run?
Mixed a fresh batch of nutrient solution, EC at one point six.
The payment service has been quiet all week, knock on wood.
What did the mechanic say about the brake pads?
Il notaio può vederci giovedì per la firma del contratto.
Deploy went out clean this Friday, zero rollbacks.
Sold two more synths, keeping the Prophet and the modular.
Tomatoes might be too heavy for the rack, sticking to greens.
Booked flights to Lisbon for the final apartment inspection.
The caponata recipe is officially transcribed, all four hours of it.
My resting heart rate dropped four beats since the training block.
The new hire shipped her first fix on day two, great sign.
The misting pump still fires every fifteen minutes like clockwork.
Loft inspection done, the terrace drain needs fixing before winter.
The container ships next Tuesday, everything is boxed.
Spinach bolted in the heat, pulled it and reseeded.
Quanto paghiamo di affitto al mese adesso?
Fifteen kilometer long run done, legs are toast.
The modular case needs a new power supply before the move.
Friday's deploy included the payment service hardening work.
朝の五時に起きて走ると涼しくて気持ちいい。
The notary signing went smoothly, keys in September.
What brand are the misting nozzles?
Nutrient reservoir now lasts nine days with the cooler weather.
Office is switching badge systems next month, they say.
Sent the bike storage form to the building manager.
The kale in the rack is outgrowing the lettuce two to one.
Madeira in October for the levada hiking week, flights booked.
Deploys go out Friday mornings, that cadence is now team law.
Half marathon pace run felt easy, training is working.
The container cleared customs in Sines already.
Replaced the rack's humidity sensor, the old one drifted again.
The loft keys handover is set for the ninth of September.
Did we ever book the ferry crossing to the Azores?
New nutrient mix trial: kale loves it, basil hates it.
The payment service passed the quarterly audit clean.
Prophet repair kit arrived, keys feel brand new.
Farewell dinner with the Houston crew got scheduled.
How long does the reservoir last now?
Twenty two kilometer run, longest ever, knee perfect.
The kale harvest filled two salad bowls, gave one to the neighbor.
Lease says the terrace awning needs building approval, checking.
Wrapped the synths in three layers of foam, movers approved.
Landed in Lisbon, the loft echoes without furniture.
The container arrives Thursday between eight and noon.
Set up a temporary desk on the terrace, working in the sun.
What's the name of Dana's puppy?
The espresso bar downstairs knows my order after two days.
When do deploys go out?
First run along the Tejo, flat and fast.
What's the wifi password at the coworking space?
The rack survived shipping, only one cracked fitting.
Come si chiama il cucciolo di Dana?
Neighbors invited us for aperitivo on the rooftop.
What did we decide about tomatoes in the rack?
Lisbon feels like the right call, finally.
